resources.string: To show notifications here, allow notification access for Mozaik.
Mozaik brings back the Windows Phone 8.1 experience. Let\'s set up a couple of things. You can change them later in Settings.
Set Mozaik as the default Home app so the Start button always brings you here.
Notification access lets tiles show counters, the Action Center list your notifications and the Music tile show what\'s playing.
To show your call history, Phone needs access to your call log.
To show your contacts, allow access to them.
To show your conversations and send texts, Messaging needs access to SMS.
To show your appointments, allow access to your calendar.
To play music stored on your phone, allow access to audio files.
To show your photos, allow access to images.
Mark people as favorites in People to see them here.
Messaging is not your default SMS app, so it can read and send texts but cannot receive them or mark them as read.
MMS is not supported yet. Open it in another messaging app.
No music found on this phone.
No appointments in the next 30 days.
Windows Phone status bar (instead of Android\'s)
The picture shows through the tiles, like on Windows Phone 8.1.
The Windows Phone lock screen appears in front of the Android lock screen. Swiping it up hands over to Android, so your PIN, pattern, fingerprint or face unlock keep protecting the phone.
Allow \"display over other apps\" so the lock screen can appear when the screen turns off.
Notification access lets Mozaik show your notifications in the Action Center, count them on live tiles and on the lock screen, and show what other music apps are playing.
Changing the brightness of the whole phone needs the \"modify system settings\" permission.

Mozaik is a fan-made recreation, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or Nokia. Developer: João Gabriel. Open Sans font (SIL Open Font License). Weather icons: Meteocons by Bas Milius (MIT). Weather photos: Wikimedia Commons, public domain / CC0. Forecasts: Open-Meteo.
Mozaik works as your Home app: the Start button opens the Start screen and it starts automatically after the phone restarts.
It\'s not your Home app yet.
If another launcher was chosen, open Android Settings › Apps › Default apps › Home app.
Call history is kept by the Android Phone app in the lite edition.
Photos slideshow (when no picture is chosen)

The Mozaik keyboard brings back Word Flow from Windows Phone 8.1: swipe across the letters to write, get suggestions and autocorrect in many languages, long-press keys for accents, and slide on the space bar to move the cursor.

Tips: swipe left on backspace to delete a word; hold the space bar to switch keyboards; the globe key changes language when you use more than one; tap a suggestion right after Word Flow to replace the word; backspace right after an autocorrection undoes it.
Choose the keyboard languages. Every Latin-script language also gets its accents by holding a key. Chinese is not available: use another keyboard for it.

Call history, speed dial and the keypad in the Windows Phone style. Calls go through Android, so emergency calls and carrier features keep working.
Your contacts with letter groups, favourites, search and profiles.
Contact photos on the live tile.
Text conversations in Windows Phone bubbles. Can be your phone\'s SMS app.
Your music collection, MixRadio-style mixes, a Windows Phone player, a real equalizer, favourites and playlists.

New interface (beta) in the style of Nokia MixRadio: \"play me\" radio, big time over what\'s playing, mixes in a sideways canvas, black-and-white pictures and round buttons in the player. Switch between the new and the classic interface in the ... menu. Also: select and delete in bulk, edit tags, hide the unknown artist.
Camera roll, albums, viewer and an editor with filters.
Lumia Camera style: photos and videos, flash, timer, grid, front camera and pro exposure and zoom.

Sharp vector maps that rotate and tilt (3D), your location, search with suggestions, press and hold for an address, routes by car, bike or on foot with turn-by-turn steps, map styles.
No route found. Check your location and the internet connection.
Off: selfies are saved the way others see you, not mirrored like the viewfinder.
Photo modes such as HDR, night and portrait use your phone\'s own image processing, when its maker offers it for that camera.
12 MP combines the pixels of high-resolution sensors (50-108 MP) for cleaner, brighter photos, like the phone\'s own camera. Maximum keeps every pixel but is noisier in low light.

Mozaik Fusion: each photo is a burst of 6 to 8 frames, aligned and merged (less noise, sky and shadows kept, like HDR+ and Deep Fusion), then the AI recognises the scene (people, food, landscape, sky, plants, animals, sunset, night) and tunes colour and sharpness. On the phone, without internet.
No news right now. Check your connection and refresh.
News come from the outlets\' own public feeds (RSS); each story opens in a reading view, with a link to the original page.

Brazilian news like Bing News on Windows Phone: top stories, Brazil, economy, world, sports, technology and entertainment from g1, Folha, CNN Brasil, BBC News Brasil, Agência Brasil and more; reading view; live tile with the headlines.
